This sheet continues and CLOSES the หมวดงานโครงสร้าง category opened on หน้า67 (แผ่นที่ 2/22) - the last row there was '1.9 SOLID PLANK...' + its topping-slab continuation row, both 108 ตร.ม.; this sheet opens with item 1.10 งานเหล็กรูปพรรณ (light-gauge steel section work).

'1.10' sub-items use a printed cross-section profile symbol (a bracket-shaped glyph, transcribed as '[') before the dash and dimension string, matching the same convention documented on other houses' equivalent structural-steel BOQ rows (a lipped C-channel/light-gauge-channel icon) - the glyph's exact shape could not be verified beyond 'bracket-like' at available zoom (flagged symbol_glyph_uncertain on those 2 rows), but the printed dimensions (150x50x20x3.2, 100x50x20x3.2) and quantities (284, 704 กก.) are clearly legible. Per spec §6a this is likely a lipped C-channel (d x b x lip x thickness); not converted to a structured steel_section object here since this is a material_list BOQ row, not a section/schedule spec entry.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet, including the 'รวมข้อ 1' subtotal row - transcribed as null, not invented.
